proof_body:
by
  intro G _ N H _ hinf hsup
  have hc : N.IsComplement' H := by
    apply Subgroup.isComplement'_of_disjoint_and_mul_eq_univ (disjoint_iff.mpr hinf)
    rw [← Subgroup.normal_mul, hsup]
    rfl
  exact ⟨_, fun h n => rfl, ⟨SemidirectProduct.mulEquivSubgroup hc⟩⟩
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (N H : Subgroup G) [N.Normal], N ⊓ H = ⊥ → N ⊔ H = ⊤ → ∃ φ : H →* MulAut N, (∀ (h : H) (n : N), ((φ h n : N) : G) = h * n * (h : G)⁻¹) ∧ Nonempty (N ⋊[φ] H ≃* G)
